page.layout: One printed page: a single column of running text. Running head at top right, in a black bar, illegible. Page number at top left. Left margin: a smudged mark beside "que affici". No notes readable.

main_text.p: beo. Q. an debeat. R. quia cū tibi eum non ita multo post suam dië obtulerim, iniquū. esset, me ob levem culpam tam gravi detrimento, poenâ [illegible, ~3 letters]que affici. F. At lex sine exce-ptione scripta est, sive parvi, sive magni temporis mora interposita fit. D. An cum ę-quum fit ob levem culpam non gravem poenam impo-ni, tamen quia Lex indefinitę scripta est, directò sequenda fit. Hic cum æquitate ius con-tendit apertissimè. Ius enim petitor, æquitatem reus ur-get. Paulus hac de re consul-tus in L. si servū, 91. §. 1. D. de verborū obligationibus: Si-ve-

page.notes: The left margin mark beside "que affici" is smudged and only partly legible; the note above is a best reading. The running head bar is decorative and its wording cannot be read. The word "ę-quum" at the line end is doubtful: the abbreviation before "quum" may be æ, so check against the scan. "dië" and "indefinitę" are copied as printed. The last line "ue-" is a line-end fragment and is kept as printed, with u changed to v.
